# Innovative
# Sensor

[See All Products][63]

^{Who we are} Mantracourt Electronics design and manufacture innovative, high performance, strain
bridge measurement products for a wide range of industry segments. Designed for load cells, strain
gauges, pressure sensors, torque transducers, flow sensors and temperature sensors.  As well as,
signal conditioning, display and control using analogue, and digital and wireless techniques.

As a company, we specialise in miniature high performance electronic products giving high accuracy,
performance and speed.

Based near Exeter in the South-West of England, we are an established technology provider to many
major OEM sensor manufacturers, with a product range of over 1000 designs.  We produce measurement
technologies including weight, strain gauge, load cell, force measurement, temperature, pressure,
voltage, current, potentiometer, rate, flow, LVDT, displacement, inclination, vibration and torque
in either analogue, digital or wireless technologies.

To keep in touch with new product releases, news and engineering insights, please register to
receive our email newsletter using the links on the left panel.

## Solutions
## by Industry

### Agriculture

Our agriculture telemetry system products can be found in several key areas within the industry in
particular within control systems for tractors and other agricultural machinery.

[Learn More][64]
[Image of field of wheat to represent the Agriculture Industry and Industries.]

### Automotive

Fast precision measurement is essential in high performance motor sport. Mantracourt works closely
with several international F1 motor teams and high end car manufacturers, often providing bespoke
solutions.

[Learn More][65]
[Close up image of car engine to represent Automotive Industry and Industries]

### Live Performance

Broadweigh gives rigging professionals a clear understanding of what is happening on their rig at
all times. A tool to achieve incredible results whilst achieving a safe working environment.

[Learn More][66]
[Image of performers on stage to represent load monitoring in the Entertainment and Live Performance
Industry]

### Marine

The marine industry’s requirement for measurement is a particular passion for Mantracourt.

[Learn More][67]
[Image of offshore oil rigs to represent Marine Industry and Industries]

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

## ABOUT US

Depth Technology Limited, headquartered in Hong Kong, is a specialized manufacturer and exporter of
high-quality truck components, with a strong focus on precision sensors for heavy-duty vehicles.
Leveraging robust production capabilities and a global outlook, we serve clients across
international markets.

Core Business

Our core business centers on the manufacturing and export of truck parts, especially sensors (e.g.,
Map sensor and Maf sensor). We supply a full range of components—from engine systems to chassis
parts—tailored for brands like Sinotruk, Shacman, and FAW. Our products are exported to regions
including Russia, Southeast Asia,Middle East, Africa, and Europe.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

# HENSOLDT - Innovations for a safer world

HENSOLDT is a leading European technology company in the defence and security sector with decades of
operational experience. The company develops mission-critical sensor solutions, optronics, defence
electronics and integrated systems for applications across all domains – land, air, sea, cyber and
space.

**Multi-Domain Solutions**
As a solutions house, we provide manufacture-independent system integration and develop, realise,
support, and operate complex systems.

**Optronics, Radar and EW**
As a technology leader, we develop innovative, readily available software-driven products in the
fields of radar, electromagnetic warfare, avionics and optronics.

**Services and training**
As a service provider, we offer services for the entire life cycle of our products as well as
tailored trainings, simulation tools and secure data as a service.

## HENSOLDT Insights

In-depth information and developments
June 19, 2026
[ Land][37]

### The future of the tank in the age of drones

The debate has intensified: Drones are reshaping the battlefield, traditional systems appear
vulnerable and the role of the main battle tank is increasingly being called into question. In
European countries, especially, the Leopard 2 is at the center of this discussion. However, the
conclusion that “tanks are obsolete” falls short.

The reality is more complex: Modern battlefields are evolving into highly networked, sensor-driven
environments where visibility, reaction speed, and information superiority are crucial. The central
question is not whether tanks like the Leopard have a future, but rather: How must it evolve to
survive in an ever-changing environment?

## Our Solutions.

Regardless of your industry, application or size requirements, Himmelstein has the ideal torque
transducer and related instrumentation to suit your project.

Industries We Serve: 
* [Automotive][66]
* [Aerospace][67]

Torque Transducer, Torque Sensor & Torque Meter Manufacturer

S. Himmelstein and Company designs and manufactures superior torque measurement instrumentation. Our
products offer significant advantages over competitive models, providing accurate and reliable
measurement of torque in rotating applications under real-world conditions, not just in the
calibration stand. When you need to quantify product performance, validate product quality, or
monitor and control continuous processes, turn to Himmelstein.

Precise Torque Products and Calibration Services

Standard products include rotating and reaction sensors from 10 ozf-in (0.07 N-m) to 22,000,000
lbf-in (2,500 kN-m) in virtually every mechanical configuration. All employ state-of-the-art strain
gage technology and are calibrated CW and CCW to full capacity in our [ISO/IEC 17025:2017][71]
accredited laboratory. Plus, we offer a wide array of accredited torque calibration services for our
own and other manufacturers’ torque transducers.

Himmelstein Products Are Proudly Made in America

Established in 1960, S. Himmelstein and Company makes the world’s best torque sensors, transfer
standards and instrumentation. Company innovations have created many advances in torque sensing
technology. We design, manufacture and test these products in Hoffman Estates, Illinois where our
state-of-the-art machine shop and test and engineering facilities permit complete control of the
manufacturing process.

# Innovative
# Sensor
# Solutions

[See All Products][63]

^{Who we are} Mantracourt Electronics design and manufacture innovative, high performance, strain
bridge measurement products for a wide range of industry segments. Designed for load cells, strain
gauges, pressure sensors, torque transducers, flow sensors and temperature sensors.  As well as,
signal conditioning, display and control using analogue, and digital and wireless techniques.

As a company, we specialise in miniature high performance electronic products giving high accuracy,
performance and speed.

Based near Exeter in the South-West of England, we are an established technology provider to many
major OEM sensor manufacturers, with a product range of over 1000 designs.  We produce measurement
technologies including weight, strain gauge, load cell, force measurement, temperature, pressure,
voltage, current, potentiometer, rate, flow, LVDT, displacement, inclination, vibration and torque
in either analogue, digital or wireless technologies.

To keep in touch with new product releases, news and engineering insights, please register to
receive our email newsletter using the links on the left panel.

# Innovative
# Sensor
# Solutions

[See All Products][63]

^{Who we are} Mantracourt Electronics design and manufacture innovative, high performance, strain
bridge measurement products for a wide range of industry segments. Designed for load cells, strain
gauges, pressure sensors, torque transducers, flow sensors and temperature sensors.  As well as,
signal conditioning, display and control using analogue, and digital and wireless techniques.

As a company, we specialise in miniature high performance electronic products giving high accuracy,
performance and speed.

Based near Exeter in the South-West of England, we are an established technology provider to many
major OEM sensor manufacturers, with a product range of over 1000 designs.  We produce measurement
technologies including weight, strain gauge, load cell, force measurement, temperature, pressure,
voltage, current, potentiometer, rate, flow, LVDT, displacement, inclination, vibration and torque
in either analogue, digital or wireless technologies.

To keep in touch with new product releases, news and engineering insights, please register to
receive our email newsletter using the links on the left panel.

# Department of Physics
1. [U of G Homepage][21]
2. [Department of Physics][22]

## A hub for scientific discovery and hands-on learning

The Department of Physics at the University of Guelph is a dynamic and research-intensive academic
unit within the College of Computational, Mathematical, and Physical Sciences. It offers a
comprehensive range of programs at the undergraduate, graduate, and postdoctoral levels, fostering a
vibrant learning environment for students passionate about exploring the universe—from the subatomic
to the cosmic scale.

With 16 dedicated research and teaching faculty members, the department supports over 175
undergraduate and more than 40 graduate students. It is known for its strong emphasis on both
teaching excellence and cutting-edge research. Faculty members are actively engaged in
collaborations with prestigious institutions such as the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), NASA, the
Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics, the Canadian Light Source, and TRIUMF.

Whether you're beginning your academic journey or pursuing advanced research, the University of
Guelph’s Department of Physics offers a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment to
explore the fundamental laws of nature.

# Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Robotik

## Führende Drehmoment-Technologie für Ihre Cobots, Medizinroboter und Force-Feedback-Lösungen.

Der Name Sensodrive steht seit 20 Jahren für innovative Drehmoment-Technologie.
Unsere marktführenden Drehmomentsensoren setzen weltweit Maßstäbe und mit unseren SensoJoints bieten
wir Ihnen als einziger Hersteller überhaupt sensitive, drehmomentgeregelte Komplettantriebe für Ihre
Robotik-Lösungen – ebenfalls mit führender Technologie.

**Unser Anspruch: Ihnen das leichteste, kompakteste, ****feinfühligste und sicherste Robotergelenk
weltweit zu bieten.**

 

 

## **Sensodrive feiert eine Revolution in der Robotik!**

### **Es gibt einen Grund zu feiern – und was für einen! Sensodrive hat mit den SensoJoints einen
### bahnbrechenden Meilenstein in der Robotik-Entwicklung erreicht.**

**Nach tausenden Entwicklungsstunden, unzähligen aufwendigen Testreihen und einer umfangreichen
Dokumentation ist es nun offiziell:
Am 25.03.2025 haben die SensoJoint safe Komplettantriebe von Sensodrive ihre
Sicherheitszertifizierung vom TÜV Süddeutschland erhalten!
****Damit sind die SensoJoint safe die weltweit ersten und einzigen drehmomentgeregelten
Roboterantriebe mit Sicherheitszertifizierung.
Diese innovativen, einbaufertigen Antriebsmodule setzen neue Maßstäbe in der Robotik und eröffnen
völlig neue Möglichkeiten für verschiedenste Anwendungen.**

unermüdlichem Einsatz und grenzenlosem Innovationswillen wurde Sensodrive mit einem der Hauptpreise

Ehrung – ein Meilenstein, der unser revolutionäres SensoJoint Robotik-Antriebssystem in den Fokus
rückt.**

Dann sind die sensitiven SensoJoint Komplettantriebe für Sie die perfekte Lösung.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

# Toyota CH-R: manuals and technical information

Owners manuals, service and repair manuals, electric wire diagrams and other information


[Toyota CH-R: manuals and technical information]

Designed to stand out both within the Toyota line-up and in its segment, the all-new Toyota C-HR -
or Coupe High-Rider - represents Akio Toyoda's determination to allow greater stylistic freedom and
promote engineering creativity in order to achieve eye-catching designs and enhanced driving
pleasure. Toyota C-HR’s distinctive design stands out for all the right reasons — without even
trying. Its fit lower body sits atop available 18-in. wheels to help give this city cruiser one
powerful stance. C-HR’s higher height and its steeply raked rear window work together to create a
sporty, passenger-friendly cabin, as well as a uniquely distinct silhouette. Its standard
projector-beam halogen headlights with unique cluster LED Daytime Running Lights (DRL), along with
its cantilevered rear spoiler, all add to C-HR’s sharp and edgy look and feel.

# TRID

TRID is an integrated database that combines the records from TRB’s Transportation Research
Information Services ([TRIS][23]) Database and the OECD’s Joint Transport Research Centre’s
International Transport Research Documentation ([ITRD][24]) Database. TRID provides access to 1.5
million records of transportation research worldwide.

[ Video New TRID Video Tutorial Series is available! ][25]

This series includes short videos on starting your transportation research with TRID as well as
basic and advanced search techniques to get the most out of the database.

Due to licensing restrictions, the TRID database, or any portion thereof, may not be used to train
any Large Language Model (LLM).

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

ensures stable availability during peaks.

carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

# HENSOLDT - Innovations for a safer world

HENSOLDT is a leading European technology company in the defence and security sector with decades of
operational experience. The company develops mission-critical sensor solutions, optronics, defence
electronics and integrated systems for applications across all domains – land, air, sea, cyber and
space.

**Multi-Domain Solutions**
As a solutions house, we provide manufacture-independent system integration and develop, realise,
support, and operate complex systems.

**Optronics, Radar and EW**
As a technology leader, we develop innovative, readily available software-driven products in the
fields of radar, electromagnetic warfare, avionics and optronics.

**Services and training**
As a service provider, we offer services for the entire life cycle of our products as well as
tailored trainings, simulation tools and secure data as a service.

June 19, 2026
[ Land][37]

### The future of the tank in the age of drones

The debate has intensified: Drones are reshaping the battlefield, traditional systems appear
vulnerable and the role of the main battle tank is increasingly being called into question. In
European countries, especially, the Leopard 2 is at the center of this discussion. However, the
conclusion that “tanks are obsolete” falls short.

The reality is more complex: Modern battlefields are evolving into highly networked, sensor-driven
environments where visibility, reaction speed, and information superiority are crucial. The central
question is not whether tanks like the Leopard have a future, but rather: How must it evolve to
survive in an ever-changing environment?

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies

reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee

#### Secondary Research

published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and

stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios

player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and

bandwidth, with more than double the RF contact density of existing VITA 67 solutions.

# Department of Physics
1. [U of G Homepage][21]
2. [Department of Physics][22]

## A hub for scientific discovery and hands-on learning

The Department of Physics at the University of Guelph is a dynamic and research-intensive academic
unit within the College of Computational, Mathematical, and Physical Sciences. It offers a
comprehensive range of programs at the undergraduate, graduate, and postdoctoral levels, fostering a
vibrant learning environment for students passionate about exploring the universe—from the subatomic
to the cosmic scale.

With 16 dedicated research and teaching faculty members, the department supports over 175
undergraduate and more than 40 graduate students. It is known for its strong emphasis on both
teaching excellence and cutting-edge research. Faculty members are actively engaged in
collaborations with prestigious institutions such as the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), NASA, the
Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics, the Canadian Light Source, and TRIUMF.

Whether you're beginning your academic journey or pursuing advanced research, the University of
Guelph’s Department of Physics offers a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment to
explore the fundamental laws of nature.

# Toyota CH-R: manuals and technical information

Owners manuals, service and repair manuals, electric wire diagrams and other information


[Toyota CH-R: manuals and technical information]

Designed to stand out both within the Toyota line-up and in its segment, the all-new Toyota C-HR -
or Coupe High-Rider - represents Akio Toyoda's determination to allow greater stylistic freedom and
promote engineering creativity in order to achieve eye-catching designs and enhanced driving
pleasure. Toyota C-HR’s distinctive design stands out for all the right reasons — without even
trying. Its fit lower body sits atop available 18-in. wheels to help give this city cruiser one
powerful stance. C-HR’s higher height and its steeply raked rear window work together to create a
sporty, passenger-friendly cabin, as well as a uniquely distinct silhouette. Its standard
projector-beam halogen headlights with unique cluster LED Daytime Running Lights (DRL), along with
its cantilevered rear spoiler, all add to C-HR’s sharp and edgy look and feel.

Owners manuals, service and repair manuals, electric wire diagrams and other information


[Toyota CH-R: manuals and technical information]

Designed to stand out both within the Toyota line-up and in its segment, the all-new Toyota C-HR -
or Coupe High-Rider - represents Akio Toyoda's determination to allow greater stylistic freedom and
promote engineering creativity in order to achieve eye-catching designs and enhanced driving
pleasure. Toyota C-HR’s distinctive design stands out for all the right reasons — without even
trying. Its fit lower body sits atop available 18-in. wheels to help give this city cruiser one
powerful stance. C-HR’s higher height and its steeply raked rear window work together to create a
sporty, passenger-friendly cabin, as well as a uniquely distinct silhouette. Its standard
projector-beam halogen headlights with unique cluster LED Daytime Running Lights (DRL), along with
its cantilevered rear spoiler, all add to C-HR’s sharp and edgy look and feel.

# TRID

TRID is an integrated database that combines the records from TRB’s Transportation Research
Information Services ([TRIS][23]) Database and the OECD’s Joint Transport Research Centre’s
International Transport Research Documentation ([ITRD][24]) Database. TRID provides access to 1.5
million records of transportation research worldwide.

[ Video New TRID Video Tutorial Series is available! ][25]
